Admission free. Parking also free.

Mike's Garage

Welcome to the finest garage collection in the neighborhood. Photographs only. Please do not touch anything, because Mike will need it later.

11 exhibits, 0 gift shops

Exhibit 01 · Lighting

The Work Light

Braun brand. Has seen things. Its whole job is to shine a light on problems, and a garage never runs out.

Exhibit 02 · Badge

The Ruud Emblem

A tiny round logo that looks very proud of itself. Experts agree it is shiny.

Exhibit 03 · Storage

Organizers 2, 6 and 5

Hand-numbered in marker, because a system is a system. Organizers 1, 3 and 4 are on a long vacation and have not written.

Exhibit 04 · Wrenches

Two 12 mm Wrenches

Why own two of the same wrench? Because the one you need is always in the other room, or in a friend's truck. Both Craftsman, both 12 mm.

Exhibit 05 · Measuring

The Digital Caliper

Measures things to a fraction of a millimeter, usually things that never needed measuring.

Exhibit 06 · Fastening

The Staple Gun

DeWalt, Guaranteed Tough. The chipped yellow paint suggests it has been taken up on that offer.

Exhibit 07 · Screwdrivers

The Torx T-9

Made in the USA, according to its own handle. Fits exactly one kind of screw and has opinions about the rest.

Exhibit 08 · Pliers

The Needle-Nose Pliers

Small, pointy and green-handled. Reaches places fingers were never invited.

Exhibit 09 · Hearing protection

The Ear Protectors

Black with a red stripe. Their entire job is to make the rest of this museum quieter.

Exhibit 10 · Painting

The Paint Roller Covers

Nine inches wide, three-eighths of an inch of high density fabric. Still in the bag, dreaming of a wall.

Exhibit 11 · Cold storage

The Freezer Panel

Kenmore, Heavy Duty Commercial. The power light glows with quiet confidence. The temperature alarm has nothing to report, and Mike would like to keep it that way.

More exhibits coming soon. Donations of interesting junk will not be accepted.
